title: Legacy Legal Document Summarization
business: A mid-sized law firm managing thousands of archived case files.
problem: The firm struggles with high operational costs and slow retrieval times when associates manually review lengthy, unstructured legal briefs to identify key case precedents.
solution: By leveraging the 128,000 token context window of the gpt-4-turbo-preview model, the firm can ingest entire multi-page legal documents in a single API call, allowing the model to synthesize complex arguments and extract relevant precedents without needing to chunk the text into smaller, potentially disjointed segments.
steps: Configure the application to connect to the Chat Completions endpoint using the gpt-4-0125-preview snapshot.
Pre-process legal documents into plain text format to ensure compatibility with the text-only input modality.
Construct a system prompt that defines the extraction schema for case precedents.
Send the full document text to the API, ensuring the total token count remains within the 128,000 window.
Parse the structured JSON response to update the firm's internal case management database.
outcome: Associates experience a significant reduction in time spent on initial document triage, enabling them to focus on higher-value legal strategy.
limitation: The model has a knowledge cutoff of December 2023, meaning it cannot natively understand or reference legal developments or case law established after this date; developers must verify the accuracy of citations against current legal databases.
